Game Overview

Escape From Castle Frankenstein puts players into a adventure experience centered on guide Frankenstein's monster through a chaotic 2D platform adventure. With double jumps and swift maneuvers, help him dodge traps and pitfalls in a perilous castle. Unearth hidden keys, outsmart relentless saws, and ultimately confront a fearsome boss to secure freedom and explore the world beyond.

How to Play

Escape From Castle Frankenstein keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide Frankenstein's monster through a chaotic 2D platform adventure. With double jumps and swift maneuvers, help him dodge traps and pitfalls in a perilous castle. Unearth hidden keys, outsmart relentless saws, and ultimately confront a fearsome boss to secure freedom and explore the world beyond.
